name: braw-pack
creator: laurentchicoine
category: Encoding, codecs, proxy generation, rendering, and project servers
description: Experimental local BRAW archive and recompression utility. Rebuilds H.265 archives into usable BRAW while retaining camera metadata, and can make smaller BRAW files. Lossy: retain original footage until rebuilt clips are checked. Windows and Linux builds plus unnotarized macOS beta builds; Linux GUI and interactive Mac workflows remain incompletely tested. NVIDIA accelerates supported Windows/Linux paths; CPU fallback is slower.

requirements.gpu: Optional NVIDIA acceleration on Windows/Linux; macOS beta uses CPU encoding.
requirements.dependencies: Bundled FFmpeg; Windows GUI needs WebView2; Linux GUI needs GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1, glibc 2.38+.
requirements.installation: Portable downloads; macOS 12+ beta builds are not notarized.
